Corresponding complete source is retained at app/src/main/cpp/vendor/libraw and must accompany redistributed binaries as a source bundle or equivalent download. The LibRaw build includes no optional GPL demosaic packs, RawSpeed or LibRaw DNG SDK integration. A separate Adobe DNG SDK bridge is used for Apple ProRAW; see Adobe-DNG-SDK.txt.
